verifier_note: delegate_kernel_litert.cc:290-294 returns OK before PreConvert when !NoExternalTensorsMode; HandleOutputEvents async path returns OK (514-547); only litert_benchmark_mode adds a wait, which LiteRT-LM never sets (grep); LockMetalMemory has no sync; GpuConfig.external_tensor_mode defaults false (llm_executor_settings.h:119).
